name: Combinations (C(n,k))
description: Generates all combinations of k elements chosen from a set of n using backtracking (choose/skip decisions).
aim: Generate all C(n,k) combinations by recursively choosing or skipping each element, maintaining current combination size.
howItWorks: At each position, decide: include or exclude
Include: add to current, recurse on next
When combination size reaches k: record it
Prune: if remaining elements can't fill k: backtrack early

whenToUse: Generate all subsets of specific size
alternatives: Iterative with bit mask — for small n
